title: Release notes orchestration and stakeholder review for Console + Runtime (2026.03)
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Produce a single canonical set of release notes (internal + public) for the March 2026 Console & Runtime release, coordinate reviews across Eng/Design/Sales/Support/Legal, and deliver final changelogs and marketing-ready highlights to GTM by 2026-03-20.

Scope:
- Public changelog: condensed, customer-facing bullets for product site, docs, and API changelog.
- Internal release notes: detailed engineering notes, migration guidance, known issues, mitigations, and rollback instructions for CS/Support/SE.
- Release highlights: 3–4 bullets + one short paragraph for marketing/email.

Success criteria:
- Final public changelog approved by PM/Eng/Legal by due date.
- Internal release notes published to Confluence and linked from incident runbooks.
- Translations kickoff started for key locales (EN/FR/DE/JP).

Risks and constraints:
- Eng release notes depend on ENG-2984 kernel scheduling PRs landing; if delayed, statements must be hedged.
- Security review flag added due to KMS integration notes; legal review may add copy constraints.
- Potential last-minute API behavior clarifications from runtime team may require update window on day of release.
updates: 2026-03-02: Initial draft of public & internal templates created in Google Drive (see links). Noted need for a short 'migration note' for customers using pinned model versions.
2026-03-04: Sync with Engineering (runtime leads) — confirmed batching behavior change is opt-in via config; decided to state 'opt-in improved batching' to avoid implying forced change.
2026-03-06: Design provided screenshots for Console rollout UI; added to internal doc for CS training. Designer: Leila Park.
2026-03-08: Legal requested explicit wording around 'data residency' claims. Marco updated draft to include conservative language and flagged for final Legal approval.
2026-03-10: Sales & Support review (feedback thread in #release-2026-03). Sales asked for a one-line value prop for Dedicated customers — added under release highlights.
2026-03-12: Security team completed preliminary review; requested short note about KMS-rotation guidance. Marked security_review_required = true in metadata.
2026-03-13: Public draft shared with execs for awareness; requested softer language around performance numbers. Removed absolute p99 numbers pending benchmark reconciliation (ENG-3010).

2026-03-16: Create GitHub release draft linking public changelog and PRs (owner: Marco)
2026-03-17: CC Support & SE on Confluence internal notes; schedule 30-min Q&A for CS (2026-03-18)
2026-03-18: Send final copy to translations and schedule publishing windows for docs and site (owner: Growth)
2026-03-20: Publish public changelog and email customers; monitor Slack channel #release-2026-03 for issues
notes_for_reviewers: Please focus reviews on: 1) accuracy of technical behavior in public bullets, 2) any legally sensitive phrasing around data residency/KMS, 3) customer-facing mitigations for known issues. Use inline comments in the Google Doc and tag Marco for quick merges. If you need to escalate copy changes after 2026-03-17, flag in #release-2026-03 with @Marco.
postmortem_checklist: Collect feedback from CS on clarity of internal playbook
Record any late-breaking customer questions and add to FAQ
Measure open rate of release email and update GTM template if <20%
Close translation issues and update docs if corrections needed
